# GdayMeetings 0.3.1

Removes the unnecessary shared service credential and manual task execution API. All client uploads, submissions, reads and meeting searches now require scoped user OAuth. MCP continues to require authenticated user OAuth. RunPod receives only task-specific result and audio capabilities.

Task submissions always queue server transcription, require an idempotencyKey, and reject the removed execute field. Public task PATCH is removed. GDAY_API_TOKEN is no longer configured or accepted.

Upgrade the meeting-notes client together with the server and sign in using Login to Gday Meetings. Remove GDAY_API_TOKEN from deployment configuration. Keep RUNPOD_ENDPOINT_URL and RUNPOD_API_KEY on the server. No new database migration is required.

Container: ghcr.io/rankun203/gday-meetings:0.3.1 (Linux AMD64 and ARM64).
